title: Resolve concurrent workspace edits transactionally
goal: Stage agent patches against a known base and detect overlapping changes before applying them; conflicting edits produce a reviewable conflict while unrelated user modifications are preserved. Deps (vectors): VC-201-021, VC-201-023, VC-201-028. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_029_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
